digest.component_or_area: LLM provider qualification and configuration resolution
propositions: Provider qualification should be decided by membership in a static registry, not by regex shape matching of the model string prefix

A misconfigured provider name (typo) should be rejected at config-resolution time with a clear error naming the invalid provider and listing valid ones, not silently deferred until provider construction
Unknown inline provider prefixes in model strings should not raise during qualification, to preserve intact multi-colon model ids like Bedrock's anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0
The static KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES set must enumerate exactly the provider names that pydantic-ai recognizes, keeping rebar permissive only up to the boundary of its runtime dependency
Slashed provider names from pydantic-ai gateways (gateway/openai, gateway/bedrock, etc.) must be accepted as valid qualifiers, rejecting the pre-existing regex that blocked them
The bare-model inference table and test-only synthetic model doubles should be handled consistently without grandfathering names unused in production
